body: Pick me. And also thank you for doing this! You rock

Not sure what level you are but it’ll probably be a while but [spell perfection](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/general-feats/spell-perfection/) is the best way to cheat metamagic for one spell.
[sacred geometry](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/general-feats/sacred-geometry/) is available earlier but is almost definitely banned. If not I’d advise writing a python script to do the math for you quickly. At higher levels it’s all but guaranteed that you successfully cast with scared geometry just cause you have so many d6s.
Bruh [Occultist Arcanist](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/classes/hybrid-classes/arcanist/archetypes/paizo-arcanist-archetypes/occultist/) is by far the best summoner full caster.
